app.name: Matrix Wii U (Unofficial)
app.short_description: Unofficial Matrix client for Nintendo Wii U
app.long_description:
An unofficial, fan-made Matrix protocol chat client for the Nintendo Wii U (Aroma homebrew). Not affiliated with, endorsed by, or supported by the Matrix.org Foundation or New Vector Ltd.
Features: - Real-time messaging via Matrix /sync long-polling - Room list with names, topics, and avatars - Message history with senders, timestamps, and scroll - Typing indicators - On-screen touch keyboard (letters, numbers, symbols) - User-configurable homeserver (works with matrix.org or self-hosted servers)
Not yet supported: - Encrypted rooms (shown but not decrypted) - Room invites / joining new rooms
Controls: - D-Pad Up/Down: Navigate / scroll - D-Pad Left/Right: Switch panels - A: Select room - B: Go back - Y: Open message input - ZL/ZR: Scroll messages
Setup: 1. Place a TTF font at SD:/wiiu/matrix_wiiu/font.ttf 2. Launch from the Aroma Homebrew Launcher 3. Enter your homeserver, username, and password on first launch
